A total of 211 participants took part in the experiments, consisting of two total
           groups. The groups were L3 speakers of Portuguese who spoke L1 American English-L2 ... Spanish (n = 96; henceforth the L1 English group) and L1 Mexican Spanish-L2 English
              (n = 115; henceforth the L1 Spanish group). ... In each
           model, the percentage of correct responses was analyzed as a function of item type
           (preposed or postposed), group (L1 Spanish, L1 English), and their interaction, with
           participant included as a random intercept.
